props.name: label
props.description: Name of the metric, shown above the value.

props.name: value
props.description: Current value of the metric. Counts up when shown.

props.name: decimals
props.description: Number of digits shown after the decimal point.

props.name: delta
props.description: Change versus the previous period, in percent.

props.name: data
props.description: Points for the sparkline. At least two.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes added to the outer element.
